info.description: Editorial article — surfaced on the home Insights section and on /blog/[slug].

heroImageCredit.description: Photographer credit for this image, e.g. "Qwerqu Mcbrew / Unsplash". The site renders it over the bottom of the photo as "Photo By: …" — type only the name, not the "Photo By:" prefix. Leave blank to fall back to the image's Caption in the Media Library, then to a photographer encoded in the filename.

heroImageCaption.description: One short line under the photo saying what or who it shows, or why it is here (about 140 characters at most). Not the photographer credit: that goes in the credit field and shows as “Photo By:”. Don't repeat the headline. Required to publish when a photo is set.

showHeroCaption.description: Show the caption under the cover image. Off hides it on the article and in the insights listings.

showHeroCredit.description: Show the "Photo By: …" credit on the cover image, on the article and in the insights listings.

readMinutes.description: Auto-computed by the lifecycle on save from body word count.

dateDisplay.description: Whether this post's date shows on the website. 'useSiteSetting' follows the Show Blog Dates switch in Site Setting.

displayDate.description: The date shown on the website when dates are on. Filled in automatically the first time the post is published; change it to show a different date. Re-publishing does not change it.
